description:
Get safety warnings for a drug.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table drug_warning — one record = one ChEMBL drug warning (withdrawal or black box) for one or more molecules.
Key: id.
Arguments: drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by year desc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL drug warnings; absence means no warning curated, not that the drug is safe.

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
